source:
Create a Roblox R15 NPC Fighting Arena.
Features:
Spawn the player in a small arena.
Spawn 5-10 enemy NPCs around the map.
NPCs patrol until a player is nearby.
When a player gets close, NPCs chase and attack.
Player has a simple M1 punch attack with a short cooldown.
Punches deal 10 damage and have a small knockback.
NPCs have 100 health.
NPCs play a hit animation when damaged and disappear when defeated.
Defeated NPCs respawn after 10 seconds.
Show a health bar above every NPC.
Show the player's health and a kill counter on the screen.
Award 10 coins for each NPC defeated.
Include a basic shop where players can upgrade:
Damage
Max Health
Walk Speed
Save coins and upgrades using DataStore.
Organize the project into separate scripts, modules, animations, and UI. Use Roblox best practices and optimize for performance.
You can expand this later by adding stronger NPCs, waves, bosses, special abilities, and better animations once the basic arena works.

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should the arena read as a stylized toon dojo, a gritty modern fight pit, or something else?
answers.answer: Use a simple stylized toon dojo arena theme; it fits the basic Roblox fighting setup and keeps the first build clear and lightweight.

answers.ask: Is the upgrade shop a physical kiosk placed in the map, or a screen-only menu?
answers.answer: Make the shop a screen-only menu for the initial build, keeping the arena uncluttered and the upgrade flow simple.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D Roblox R15 fighting arena as a small, simple stylized toon dojo. The compact arena has an open central combat floor with dojo-style boundary walls and clear open space around the player spawn, with 5–10 enemy NPC spawn positions distributed around the perimeter and across the map. Keep the arena uncluttered; the upgrade shop is screen-only and has no physical kiosk.
